settings.heading: Gang Sheets.
settings.lede: Pack as many designs as you want onto a single A3 sheet. Maximum value, minimum waste. From $11 per sheet.

settings.title: Open the builder
settings.body: Use the canvas below to lay out your designs on an A3 sheet. Drag, drop, resize.

settings.title: Add your artwork
settings.body: Upload PNGs with transparent backgrounds at 300 DPI. The builder snaps them to a print-safe grid.

settings.title: Pack it tight
settings.body: Fill every inch — multiple sizes, multiple designs. Tighter packing means lower per-design cost.

settings.title: Order & ship
settings.body: Add to cart and check out. We print and ship within 24 hours via NZ Post tracked.

settings.heading: We'll lay it out for you.
settings.sub: Send us your PNGs and we'll arrange them on a sheet for the lowest cost. No charge.
